raw_segments.text: An elderly female, no more young, left the building of the courts of Chancery.
King's Bench, Exchequer, and Common Pleas, having heard in the Lord Chancellors court
the case in Lunacy of Potterton, in the Admiralty Division the summons, expart motion, of the
owners of the Lady Cairns versus the owners of the Bark Mona, in the Court of Appeal Reservation
of Judgment in the case of Harvey versus the Ocean Accident and Guarantee Corporation.
